title: user registration functionality
description: Test the user registration endpoint to ensure new users can register successfully with valid data and appropriate error handling for invalid inputs.

title: user login functionality
description: Verify the user login endpoint authenticates users correctly with valid credentials and returns appropriate errors for invalid credentials.

title: token verification process
description: Test the token verification endpoint to confirm that valid tokens are accepted and invalid or expired tokens are rejected.

title: otp verification mechanism
description: Validate the OTP verification endpoint to ensure correct OTPs are accepted and incorrect or expired OTPs are handled properly.

title: certificate listing and retrieval
description: Test the certificates listing and retrieval endpoints to ensure all certificates can be listed, searched, and fetched by ID correctly.

title: certificate unsave functionality
description: Verify the unsave certificate endpoint removes a saved certificate from the user's profile correctly.

title: internship listing and application
description: Test the internship endpoints for listing, searching, saving, and applying to internships, ensuring applications are recorded properly.

title: hackathon listing and save feature
description: Verify the hackathon endpoints for listing upcoming events and saving hackathons to user profiles function correctly.

title: news feed retrieval and search
description: Test the news endpoints to ensure latest news, category-based news, and search functionality work as expected.

title: user profile and skill management
description: Validate user profile retrieval, update, skill addition, removal, and retrieval of saved items and applications for accuracy and persistence.
